name: Kosuge (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kosuge village emblem in green: a winged ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kosuge, a village in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 August 1971.

features.role: Kosuge village emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised character
